summary: Iteration 22, frontend only, tested with Playwright at 1920x1080 against the preview URL. All requested flows passed. Crypto Plan tab: plan-scenarios-note is present. The 4 cards show PRUDENTE 2.5% mensual, REALISTA 4% mensual, AMBICIOSO 6% mensual and SEGÚN BACKTEST -9.44% mensual. The old names Conservador/Base/Optimista no longer appear as card names. Clicking Ambicioso gives it an amber border and the projection shows '6%/mes'. GET /api/settings returned plan_scenario=optimista, and it was restored to base afterwards. The intro mentions 'Prudente / Realista / Ambicioso'. Projection, phases and Monte Carlo still render. FX Plan tab: PRUDENTE 1.5%, REALISTA 3%, AMBICIOSO 5% (all 'mensual') plus the note. The FX scenario was left as base. AI usage chip: crypto shows 'IA hoy 3' and FX 'IA hoy 2', both matching status.ai_usage.total. 'Claude Sonnet 5.5' appears next to it. The title includes señales, noticias, revisiones and ambos bots. News: crypto news-updated showed 'Actualizado 21:31:56 · cada 20 min' (bot running). After news-refresh-button (about 6 s) it showed 'Actualizado 21:34:44 · cada 20 min', and the chip went from 3 to 4 within 11 s, matching the API (news 4, total 4). FX fxnews-updated showed 'Actualizado 21:20:28 · cada 60 min' with the FX bot stopped; Actualizar ahora was not pressed in FX. Settings hints are present for crypto (news-section) and FX (fxnews-section). The bot selector works, and there were no console errors on either dashboard. The crypto bot was not stopped; the FX bot stayed stopped.

issues: The '· cada N min' suffix uses text-slate-600 on a very dark background, so contrast is low and it is barely readable

action_items: Optional: raise contrast of the '· cada N min' suffix (e.g. text-slate-500/400)
critical_code_review_comments: UsageChip only shows '· M ahorradas' when skipped_news>0, which is fine. The 'IA hh:mm · fuentes hh:mm' variant was not observed live (both cycles had AI run); its logic is code-reviewed only (analysis_at !== updated_at).
